baseline_menu.composition_ablation: pooled overlap and hierarchical affine; same intercept and penalties
baseline_menu.kernel: unchanged candidates() from tools/improve_residual_model.py; inner-selected all families
baseline_menu.reduced_rank: linear residual ridge with fitted-output rank [4,8,16] and alpha [.1,1,10]
baseline_menu.selection: equal-pair all-gene inner MSE; ties by menu order; no outer-score choice

config.negative_result: retain all scores; no post-score rescue grid; decide once whether to continue
config.promotion: at least 2 percent lower MSE than development-selected strongest baseline in both sources and both split protocols; conditional paired bootstrap upper loss difference below zero on random splits
config.scope: exposed development only; read profiles.npz, never evaluator responses
config.secondary: MSE weighted by training-only gene response variance, normalized to mean one
